name: Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension / Log Size Ratio
details: For every finite non-singleton binary class.
proof: If an admissible projection on $m$ coordinates has VC dimension $d$, its shattered-set family is downward closed with all faces of size at most $d$. Hence $|\mathcal H|\leq|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H_{|S})|\leq\sum_{i=0}^d\binom mi\leq(m+1)^d\leq(n+1)^d$. Taking logarithms yields $\mathrm{SCVC}(\mathcal H)\geq\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)$.
witness_verification: For #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $\frac{\log(2^n-1)}{\log(n+1)}$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
